outcome: Mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) of hepatitis B virus (HBV)
cohort: 1384 women paired with 1407 infants born to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive pregnant women
finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with a decreased risk of mother-to-child transmission of HBV.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with a decreased risk of HBV MTCT (OR = 0.26; 95% CI: 0.07-0.95; P = 0.042).
